verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's pricing page states that it supports unlimited calendars across Google, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail, and that all of them are checked for conflicts. That covers the Google, Outlook, and Apple multi-calendar conflict checking the story asks for. The claim rests on a single vendor marketing line, though. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how conflict checking works (sync frequency, per-calendar settings), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked
